title: Resetting Your Account Password
questions: How do I reset my password?
Forgot my password what should I do?
Can I change my login password?
Where is the password reset link?
How to recover lost account password
password bhool gaya, reset kaise kare
answer: To reset your password, visit the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email address and click 'Send Recovery Link'. Check your inbox for the reset link, which expires after 30 minutes.

title: Downloading Past Invoices and Receipts
questions: How can I download my invoice?
Where do I find my past receipts?
Need VAT tax invoice for accounting
How to access billing history and invoices
Can I get a PDF receipt for my payment?
send me a copy of last month's invoice
I need an invoice for my company records
answer: Navigate to Settings > Billing & Invoices. Scroll down to the 'Payment History' table where you can view and download all past invoices and tax receipts in PDF format.

title: Updating Your Account Email Address
questions: How do I update my registered email?
Can I transfer my login email?
Where to update my contact email
change the email on my profile
my email changed, how do I update it
answer: Go to Profile > Account Details. Click 'Edit' next to your email address, enter your new email, and submit. You will receive verification emails at both old and new addresses to confirm the change.

title: Upgrading or Changing Your Subscription Plan
questions: Can I downgrade from Pro to Basic?
How do I change my subscription?
change from monthly to yearly billing
answer: Go to Settings > Subscription. Choose your desired plan (Basic, Pro, or Enterprise) and select monthly or annual billing. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing.

title: Refund Policy and Request Process
questions: How do I request a refund?
Can I get money back for accidental charge?
how long does a refund take
answer: We offer a full 14-day money-back guarantee for initial subscription purchases. For accidental duplicate charges or billing disputes, submit a ticket under Billing and our finance team will process eligible refunds within 3-5 business days.

title: Enabling Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
questions: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
Add two step verification to my account
how do I secure my account with an authenticator
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Toggle 2FA ON, scan the QR code using Google Authenticator or Authy, and enter the 6-digit confirmation code. Save your backup recovery codes securely.

title: Exporting Your Workspace Data
questions: How do I export my data?
Can I download all customer records?
Where to find data export options
download a backup of my workspace
answer: Administrators can navigate to Workspace Settings > Data Management > Export. Select either CSV or JSON format and click 'Generate Archive'. An encrypted download link will be emailed within 10 minutes.

title: Tracking Hardware & Physical Deliveries
questions: How do I track my package delivery?
When will my security key or hardware arrive?
answer: Check your dispatch confirmation email for the courier tracking code and carrier URL. Deliveries usually take 3-5 business days domestically. If tracking shows no scans for over 48 hours, contact logistics support.

title: Managing Notification and Email Preferences
questions: How do I turn off email notifications?
answer: Visit Preferences > Notifications. Customize your alerts for email, browser push notifications, and daily summaries by toggling the relevant switches.

title: Customizing Theme and Dark Mode
questions: How do I enable dark mode?
Where is the light mode switch?
Can I change the dashboard theme?
Would be nice to have dark mode
answer: Click your user avatar in the top right corner and toggle 'Dark Mode' or select 'System Default' to sync with your operating system preferences.

title: Account Cancellation and Data Deletion
questions: How do I close my account?
Delete my personal profile and data
how to permanently delete my profile
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Danger Zone. Click 'Delete Account' and enter your password. Account deletion is permanent after a 14-day grace period.

title: Generating and Managing API Keys
questions: How do I generate an API key?
Where can I find my secret developer token?
where do I get API credentials
answer: Developers can visit Settings > Developer > API Keys. Click 'Create New Secret Key', name the key, assign permissions, and copy the key immediately as it will not be displayed again.

title: Configuring Single Sign-On (SSO / SAML)
questions: Set up Okta or Azure AD Single Sign On
Where do I enter Identity Provider metadata?
answer: Enterprise workspace owners can navigate to Security > SAML SSO. Paste your IdP Entity ID, SSO URL, and x.509 certificate. Test authentication with the provided simulation button before enforcing SSO.

title: Updating Billing Address and Tax Details
answer: Go to Billing > Payment Methods > Edit Billing Address. Update company name, street, postal code, and tax/VAT ID. Changes apply to all future generated invoices.

title: Managing Active Sessions and Logging Out
questions: How do I log out of other devices?
Someone else logged into my device session
see where I am logged in
answer: Under Security > Active Sessions, review all current devices, IP addresses, and login times. Click 'Sign Out All Other Devices' to invalidate any unauthorized active sessions immediately.

title: Can't Log In or Account Locked
questions: I can't log in to my account
login page keeps saying invalid credentials
how do I unlock my account
answer: After 5 failed attempts accounts lock for 15 minutes. Wait, then use 'Forgot Password' to set a new one. If you still cannot sign in, check that SSO is not enforced for your workspace (Settings > Security) or contact support with your workspace name.

title: Updating Your Payment Method
questions: how do I update my credit card
my card expired, how do I add a new one
answer: Go to Billing > Payment Methods > Add Card. Enter the new card, set it as default, and remove the old one. Future renewals will be charged to the default card.

title: Inviting Team Members and Managing Seats
questions: how do I add a user
invite a colleague to my workspace
answer: Workspace admins can open Settings > Members > Invite. Enter email addresses and pick a role (Admin, Member, Viewer). Extra seats are billed pro rata from the next invoice.

title: Lost Access to Your 2FA Device
questions: I lost my phone with the authenticator
new phone, how do I move my authenticator
answer: Sign in with one of your backup recovery codes, then go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication to re-register your new device. Without backup codes, contact support for an identity-verified reset (takes up to 24 hours).

title: Using the Mobile App
questions: how do I use the app on my phone
answer: Our apps are free on the App Store and Google Play: search 'Triage Router'. Sign in with the same account; enable push notifications in the app settings.

title: Connecting Slack and Other Integrations
answer: Open Settings > Integrations, choose Slack, Teams or Webhooks and click Connect. Pick the channel and the events to forward. Webhooks need an HTTPS endpoint.

title: Usage Limits and Quotas
questions: how many API calls can I make
answer: Free: 1 GB storage and 1,000 API calls/day. Basic: 10 GB, 10k calls. Pro: 100 GB, 100k calls. Enterprise limits are custom. See live usage under Settings > Usage; upgrade the plan to raise limits.

title: Support Hours and Response Times
answer: Support is staffed 24/7 for Enterprise and 08:00-20:00 CET on weekdays for other plans. Target first-response times: Enterprise 1h, Pro 2h, Basic 4h, Free 8h.

title: Data Privacy and GDPR Requests
questions: request a copy of my personal data
answer: Data is stored in EU data centres (Frankfurt, Stockholm). Request a copy of your personal data or a DPA from Settings > Privacy > Requests; we respond within 30 days.

title: Changing Language and Time Zone
answer: Go to Profile > Preferences to set language (English, Hindi, Swedish, German) and time zone. Times across the app update immediately.

title: Pricing, Discounts and Trials
questions: do you have student or nonprofit discounts
answer: Pro is $29/user/month (or $24 billed yearly). Nonprofits and education get 40% off via the discount form. Trials last 14 days and can be extended once by sales.
